name: MailerLite
label: MailerLite current REST — subscribers, groups, campaigns (not Classic)
description: Official MailerLite current REST at https://connect.mailerlite.com/api. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer api_token. Not Classic api.mailerlite.com. Caller owns consent. Customer owns the MailerLite account. api_token is never logged or returned. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put api_token here. subscriber.create requires email. Example: {"operation":"subscriber.get","subscriber_id_or_email":"ada@example.com"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT current-API verbs including trigger.listen. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: email
schema.description: Subscriber email for subscriber.create. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Custom fields map for subscriber.create / subscriber.update. Example: {"name":"Ada","company":"Contoso"}.

schema.label: groups
schema.description: Group ids to assign on subscriber.create / subscriber.update.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Subscriber status. EXACT: active | unsubscribed | unconfirmed | bounced | junk. create/update.

schema.label: resubscribe
schema.description: Resubscribe an unsubscribed email on subscriber.create.

schema.label: opted_in_at
schema.description: ISO datetime opted_in_at for subscriber.create.

schema.label: optin_ip
schema.description: optin_ip for subscriber.create.

schema.label: subscriber_id_or_email
schema.description: Id or email path for subscriber.get.

schema.label: subscriber_id
schema.description: Subscriber id for update/delete/group.add/group.remove.

schema.label: filter[status]
schema.description: List filter[status] for subscriber.list. EXACT: active | unsubscribed | unconfirmed | bounced | junk.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for subscriber.list.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Cursor for subscriber.list.

schema.label: include
schema.description: include query for subscriber.list. Example: groups.

schema.label: group_id
schema.description: Group id for group.add / group.remove.

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: Campaign id for campaign.send.

schema.label: delivery
schema.description: campaign.send delivery. EXACT: instant | scheduled.

schema.label: schedule
schema.description: campaign.send schedule {date, hours, minutes} when delivery=scheduled.

schema.label: __omit
schema.description: Placeholder so group.add POSTs an empty JSON object. Leave blank.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Do not log emails, phones, or secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT current-API verbs. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: API token
configurationParameters.description: MailerLite Bearer token (StudioQuack secret). Integrations → MailerLite API. Never log or place on INPUT. Classic keys do not work.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
